actionCards.name: Build
descI: Build **1 building** with a maximum size of <STRENGTH:X>.
Available: **Kiosk, pavilion, aquariums, standard enclosures** and **petting zoo**.
You may pay <MONEY:3> to build 1 additional kiosk.
descII: Build **1 or more different buildings** with a total maximum size of <STRENGTH:X>.
Newly available: **Large Bird Aviary** and **Reptile House**.
You may pay <MONEY:2> to build 1 additional kiosk.
tooltip: <SIDE_I> You may build 1 additional kiosk. You may do this even if you build a kiosk as part of your regular build action and even if you exceed the strength of your build action by 1 by building this kiosk. Pay a total cost of 3 money for the additional kiosk (the regular cost of 2 plus an extra cost of 1). You may build all buildings (including the additional kiosk) in an order of your choice.
<SIDE_II> Same as Side I, but the cost for the additional kiosk is reduced to 2 money (the regular cost).

actionCards.name: Cards
descI: Draw cards from the **deck** OR snap.
descII: Draw cards from within **reputation range** or from the **deck** OR snap.
tooltip: At level I, you can draw cards only from the deck <TAKE-IN-DECK>. At level II, you can draw either from the deck or in reputation range <TAKE-IN-DECK> <TAKE-IN-RANGE>.

actionCards.name: Animals
descII: Play animals cards from your **hand** or from within **reputation range** (with additional costs).
tooltip: At level I, you can play animal cards only from your hand <HAND-CARDS>. At level II, you can play cards either from your hand or in your reputation range by paying **the folder number as additional cost** <HAND-CARDS> <TAKE-IN-RANGE-FOLDER-COST>.

actionCards.name: Association
descI: Perform **1 association task** with a maximum value of <STRENGTH:X>.
descII: Perform **1 or more different association tasks** with a total maximum value of <STRENGTH:X>.
You may play **Conservation project** cards from within **reputation range** (with additional costs).
tooltip: At level I, you can support conservation projects either on the board or from your hand <HAND-CARDS>. At level II, you can also support conservation project in your reputation range by paying **the folder number as additional cost** <HAND-CARDS> <TAKE-IN-RANGE-FOLDER-COST>.

actionCards.name: Sponsors
descI: Play **1** sponsors card with a maximum level of <STRENGTH:X>.
Additionally, you may trade 1 <XTOKEN> marker for <MONEY:5> or vice versa.
descII: Play **1 or more** sponsors cards with a total maximum level of <STRENGTH:X>** + 1**.
Additionally, you may trade 1 <XTOKEN> marker for <MONEY:5> or vice versa **or** pay either for <REPUTATION:1>.
tooltip: At level I, you can play sponsor cards only from your hand <HAND-CARDS>. At level II, you can play cards either from your hand or in your reputation range by paying **the folder number as additional cost** <HAND-CARDS> <TAKE-IN-RANGE-FOLDER-COST>.

<SIDE_I> In addition to your action, you may pay 1 X-token to gain 5 money or pay 5 money to gain 1 X-token. You may do this before or after your Sponsors action. You may do this no matter whether you play a Sponsor card or choose the Break option. You may not use the new X-token to increase the strength of this Sponsors action.
<SIDE_II> As Side I OR you may pay 1 X-token or 5 money to gain 1 reputation.

descI: Build **1 building** with a maximum size of <STRENGTH:X>.
Available: **Kiosk, pavilion, aquariums, standard enclosures** and **petting zoo**.

descII: Build **1 or more different buildings** with a total maximum size of <STRENGTH:X>.
Newly available: **Large Bird Aviary** and **Reptile House**.
You may **cover 1 rock** or **water** space. Gain <MONEY:2> if you do.
tooltip: <SIDE_I> You may pay 2 money to cover 1 water or rock space as if it were a building space. This only applies when using this action, not when building in any other way or when placing a unique building.
<SIDE_II> Same as Side I, but instead of having to pay 2 money, you gain 2 money when you cover a water or rock space. You may still only build on 1 water or rock space per action.

immediate: Gain 1 appeal for each herbivore icon in your zoo.
income: Gain 3 money for 1 to 2 herbivore icons, 6 money for 3 to 4 herbivore icons or 9 money for 5 or more herbivore icons in your zoo in the income phase of each break.

passive: For each bird icon that is played in any zoo, gain 3 money (per icon).

immediate: Take 1 card from the deck or in reputation range
income: Take 1 card from the deck or in reputation range
endgame: Gain 1 conservation point for 3-5 research icons in your zoo; gain 2 for 6 or more.

immediate: Gain 2/5/10 money for 1/2/3 universities in your zoo.
passive: Supporting a conservation project with the Association action now only requires strength 4 (instead of 5).
endgame: Gain 1 conservation point if you have 3 universities in your zoo.
Gain 1 conservation point if your zoo has 9 or more reputation.

immediate: You may place 1 kiosk on your zoo map for free.
The usual building rules apply, including the distance rule for kiosks.
passive: In the income phase of each break, gain 1 money per kiosk all other players have on their zoo maps, no matter how much income these kiosks generate for their owners.
endgame: Gain 1 conservation point if you have 5 or more kiosks in your zoo.

passive: For each sea animal icon you play into your zoo, you may either do a) or b):
a) **Expedition**: discard 1 of your played person Sponsor cards (not from your hand) to gain 1 conservation point.
You lose all future benefits of the person Sponsor card and any icons on it, but you do not have to give back anything you gained from the person before.
b) **Scuba Dive 3**: reveal the 3 topmost cards of the deck. Choose 1 Sponsor card and add it to your hand. Discard the other cards.

immediate: You do not need to have your Association Action card upgraded to do this. The usual rules apply.
passive: Every time you make a donation, pay 1 money less for each research icon in your zoo (to a minimum of 0 money).

immediate: Gain 1 appeal for each small animal in your zoo.
passive: Every time you play a small animal, pay 3 money less for the animal than indicated on the Animal card.
Small animals are animals that require a standard enclosure of 1 or 2 spaces, as well as Petting Zoo animals.

immediate: Gain 1 appeal for each predator icon in your zoo.
income: Gain 3 money for 1 to 2 predator icons, 6 money for 3 to 4 predator icons or 9 money for 5 or more predator icons in your zoo in the income phase of each break.

immediate: Place the Side Entrance unique building on your zoo map on 2 border spaces. It does not have to be adjacent to existing buildings. Otherwise, the usual building rules apply. From now on, you may build buildings adjacent to the Side Entrance as well.
income: Gain 2 money for each building (except empty standard enclosures), that is adjacent to the Side Entrance (similar to a kiosk, except that the Side Entrance itself can be adjacent to a kiosk).
endgame: Gain 5 appeal if you have completely covered your zoo map (all spaces except the rock and water spaces).

immediate: Gain 1 appeal for every connected rock space.
endgame: Gain 1 conservation point for every 2 isolated rock spaces. Example: If you have 3 rock spaces that are isolated, you gain 1 conservation point.

immediate: Place the Sea Turtle Tank unique building on your zoo map (adjacent to at least 2 water space).
passive: For each reptile icon you play into your zoo, you may sell up to 2 cards from your hand for 4 money each (Sunbathing 2). Place the sold cards on the discard pile.
